Return Columns

Saiem Gilani

Source: vignettes/return-columns.Rmd
return-columns.Rmd

Each row is one column of a data frame a hoopR function returns: the function (fn), the element of the returned list it belongs to (component, empty for a function that returns a single data frame), the column name, its type and what it holds. Type a function name into the fn filter to see everything it returns, or a column name into col_name to find every function that returns it. The NBA and men’s college basketball functions show the same tables in their help pages; for the other families this table is the column reference.

The same table ships with the package as hoopR::return_columns, so in R subset(return_columns, fn == "nba_boxscoretraditionalv3") gives the rows for one function.

#> Warning in instance$preRenderHook(instance): It seems your data is too big for
#> client-side DataTables. You may consider server-side processing:
#> https://rstudio.github.io/DT/server.html

  author = {Saiem Gilani},
  title = {hoopR: Access Men’s Basketball Play by Play Data.},
  url = {https://hoopR.sportsdataverse.org/},
  year = {2026}
}
